title: Skales: This AI App Has a Lizard Mascot

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: A developer spent 2 hours installing Docker to run an AI agent, then realized his wife and six-year-old could never do this, so he rebuilt the whole thing. Scales is a native desktop app. Download the XE or DMG, doubleclick, done. It uses almost zero RAM and gives you a literal lizard desktop mascot.
